The '''Vorkutan Workers' Assembly''' was the city-wide coordination body associated with the [[Vorkutan Great Reorganization]] and [[Gorodovaya Syndikalizm]].

== Function ==

The assembly coordinated district kollektivy across [[Vorkutangrad]]. Workshop and factory bodies handled daily production, while district assemblies managed industrial-residential units. The city-wide assembly provided broader coordination between districts, transport systems, public services, and strategic industrial needs.

== Open Canon ==

The source gives the assembly as a major institution of the Vorkutan model but does not define its later constitutional status. Publication should not assume that it remained unchanged through 1994 without a dedicated Vorkutangrad state-history pass.
